entities.summary: César Klein was a German Expressionist painter and designer, probably best known as one of the founders the November Group and the Arbeitsrat für Kunst. He is associated with the Düsseldorf school of painting. Cesar Klein was a architects & designers from Hamburg (1876-09-14, Hamburg–1954-03-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
